user.description: Choose what you want to monitor.

menu_options.detected: Choose an actively allocated Bluetooth device
menu_options.connection_slots: Monitor free connection slots of Bluetooth adapters and proxies

detected.title: Choose a Bluetooth device
detected.description: The list contains devices that currently own an active Bluetooth connection slot and are not monitored yet. The source shown after the address is informational and is not locked into the configuration.

data_description.address: Choose the device whose connection allocation should be monitored.

manual.title: Enter a Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enter the device address, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

name.title: Name the monitor

data_description.name: Used as the Home Assistant device name when no existing device has this Bluetooth address. The suggested value is editable.

connection_slots.title: Monitor connection slots
connection_slots.description: Creates one sensor per Bluetooth adapter or proxy that reports connection slots. The sensor shows the number of free slots and is placed on the adapter's device when Home Assistant has one.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth address is already monitored.
abort.no_allocated_devices: No unmonitored, actively allocated Bluetooth devices were found. Use manual entry instead.

incompatible_api.title: Bluetooth Connection Monitor is incompatible with this Home Assistant version
incompatible_api.description: Home Assistant's Bluetooth integration no longer provides the connection-allocation methods this integration reads ({methods}). The monitors stay unavailable until a compatible version of Bluetooth Connection Monitor is installed.
